phase: Phase 2: transfer prefill wins into verifier shapes
purpose: Classify every important dense prefill owner by its verifier-row behavior, and bound the rows 2-4 IQ sibling headroom with measured numbers.

protocol.prefill_vs_verifier: scripts/gguf_iq_w4a16_crossover.py, interleaved min-of-5 rounds x 2 reps, 4 largest tensors per quant, rows 1-128, agreement screened per row.
protocol.rows1_sibling: rows==1 local32 decode owner vs the strict per-row GEMV on the same tensors at rows 1/2/4, interleaved min-of-5 x 3 reps.
protocol.launch_breakdown: Phase 1 rocprofv3 census, rows=4 native B1-B3 leaf, 8 steps.

dead_zone_coverage_pct.note: local32-capable = IQ4_XS + IQ4_NL + IQ3_S + IQ3_XXS + IQ2_S + IQ2_XS. A rows 2-4 sibling covers 94.1% (K_M) / 85.9% (K_S) of the dead-zone MACs; Q3_K needs separate work.

gguf_iq4_xs.reason: The W4A16 prefill owner loses at rows 2-4; the resident/layout is fine but the large-M tiling is the wrong geometry.

gguf_iq4_nl.reason: The W4A16 prefill owner loses at rows 2-4; the resident/layout is fine but the large-M tiling is the wrong geometry.

gguf_q3_k.classification: verifier sibling required (no rows==1 owner exists)
gguf_q3_k.reason: Q3_K has no local32 rows==1 sibling, so a rows 2-4 owner is new work rather than an extension.

gguf_iq3_xxs.reason: The W4A16 prefill owner loses at rows 2-4; the resident/layout is fine but the large-M tiling is the wrong geometry.

gguf_q4_k.reason: The t16 resident layout is shared with the cooperative WMMA prefill owner and the registered rowtile verifier sibling runs it at rows 2-4 in both UD and plain censuses; no prefill-only scoping is needed.

norm_residual.reason: Identical kernel names and comparable cost in both arms.

gate_up_silu.reason: UD already runs the Q5_K WMMA prefill dual at verifier rows and it is the cheapest gate/up arm measured; the dual SiLU path transfers without a small-row rewrite.

attention_and_gdn.reason: The GDN recurrent owner is the same kernel at the same cost in both arms; attention differs only by batch decomposition.

launch_breakdown.note: The +208 launches/step over plain is dominated by the 135 IQ strict launches; the rest is quant-mix (Q5/Q6/Q8 tensors plain does not carry). A rows 2-4 IQ sibling keeps the same 135 launches/step and only cuts each from ~237 us to the measured local32 cost (~45-115 us on the same shapes), so launch-count reduction is not part of this candidate.

findings: The strict per-row GEMV is weight-decode-bound, not row-bound: its time is flat from rows 1 to 4 (e.g. IQ4_NL ffn_down 0.554/0.530/0.534 ms). It does not rescan weights per row tile; it decodes them once per output block, and that decode is 2-7x slower than the local32 decode owner.
The W4A16 prefill owner is prefill-only at verifier rows: it loses at rows 2-4 on every IQ quant (0.21x-1.20x) and wins from 8-16 rows. Routing MTP through it is not the fix.

The rows==1 local32 decode owner already beats the strict GEMV by 2.0-7.4x at rows 2-4 on the same tensors, so the sibling is a small-row geometry of an admitted, already-measured owner, not a new arithmetic path.
Q3_K has no rows==1 local32 owner and is 2.28% (K_M) / 8.57% (K_S) of rank-2 MACs, so it stays on the strict GEMV until it gets its own owner.
No per-row-tile weight rescan was found, so row packing and launch reuse are not the lever: the same 135 launches/step stay and each one gets cheaper.
selected_action: Phase 4 candidate A: extend the local32 IQ decode family to rows 2-4 (weight decode once per output block, row loop for the activation MACs), registered as a verifier sibling with the strict GEMV retained as the fallback. Covers 94.1% (K_M) / 85.9% (K_S) of the dead-zone MACs at a measured 2.0-7.4x headroom.
limitations: Static MAC shares and leaf microbenchmarks, not end-to-end rates.
The local32 owner is approximate (max relative error <= 5.4e-3 vs the strict GEMV on these shapes) and owes the production numerical gate before any default flips.
Q3_K has no measured sibling; its rows 2-4 behavior is unknown.
Attention and GDN owners were classified from the Phase 1 census rather than re-measured at every declared row shape.
